comparisons.reason: Different constructs on the same source (OC_comments). Feature 0 detects an analogy, meaning an explicit comparison to a different familiar scenario, and it excludes plain literal examples of the same issue. Feature 1 detects a concrete, identifiable real-world example (event, person, study or statistic) cited as support, and it excludes hypotheticals. An analogy need not cite a real identifiable case, and a real case of the same issue need not be an analogy, so the per-row 0/1 outputs measure different things.
